== Original and remastered English issuer text ==
The remaster gives permission to forfeit your non-lightsaber weapons at value 3 and recirculates just-forfeited weapons. The earlier wording sends non-lightsaber weapons to their owners’ Used Piles when lost. The later pull uses a singular action in a specified phase. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16602#page=3 Players Committee original sheet, p. 3, slip 39]. [[:File:VS9O-39-Inconsequential_Losses.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=4 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 4, slip 39].
